snippet.title: Backrooms Level X | Official Release Date Trailer | Survival Horror Game
snippet.description:
Experience the chilling world of Backrooms Level X! Watch the official release date reveal for this first-person survival horror game inspired by the legendary Backrooms universe. Explore endless liminal spaces, solve challenging puzzles, and face terrifying entities and giant bosses in a unique, atmospheric adventure.

🟡 Release Date: 29 May 2025
🟡 Platforms: PC (Steam)
🟡 Coming soon on: PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch

13 levels filled with horror and mystery
Immersive exploration and narrative-driven gameplay
Challenging puzzles and environments
Atmospheric graphics and haunting sound design

Are you ready to confront your deepest fears and uncover the secrets of the Backrooms?
Add Backrooms Level X to your wishlist and subscribe for the latest updates!
